body:
https://gyazo.com/bd083e20a98c5435b96865bb9de35469

As you will see in the gyazo above, I have permission to Posighdun to make the appeal.

https://youtu.be/HTUXXwIV9iM?t=1m24s <----- Video sent by Tazz as proof. (Minute 1:24)

"What you did is humanly impossible, and is what happens when your ghost client is so bad that your aimbot code that is based off of angles doesn't reset when the angle reaches 360 degrees, forcing a 360 spin to get your aim back to 0 degrees. That is what you did there, so now you're banned for autoclicking and aim assist. " <------ Explanation of the ban made by Tazz

Ok, first, that all I want to clarify that what he said Tazz is wrong, since I never gave a 360 degree turn, because if they are placed in the video, speed 0.25 I fail to give a turn or 180 degrees.

Second, I go to ts when I got talking with Tazz, so it made me understand that I at the time of completing the giro, again the same pixel of the beginning of this. Which is wrong because if you look in detail at the turn I did not again the same pixel.

Third, I don't understand how someone with a ban from the Forum and the server, even in the BlackList (I mean NovaLikesPvP) was able to send this evidence, by ts to Tazz, I'd like to give me an explanation on this. I would like to if you need any evidence to verify this, tell me no I have no problem to them.

Carefully Maatih.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

After a senior staff vote, we have decide to keep you banned. This was decided by the numerous amount of evidence found by some of our moderators and we also felt that you were using an autoclicker/aim assist, as the ban message shows. Since you've already created multiple threads regarding your ban in the past, if you create anymore, it may lead to a punishment.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in 5-7 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Neyke
